description: D2: the Stormcaller, the old kings' bell-warden of the Drowned Steps, stands in the storm over the Stormstair - the flooded pools at the top of the Steps under the Stonehold's wall. From the look south from the Breach's top (lead.stormcaller.seen: the storm that has not moved), from finding the Stormstair or from his fall: climb into his pools, bring him down, and tell Maera at Last Hearth (her outcome storm_fallen: the storm is gone from the Drowned Steps, the Lodestone set below the Hearth's beacon, and the rumour of Harrok's banner on the road - quest.harrok_lead). Every stage completes on his death but Maera's. XP at each stage; D3: his fall lifts a giant to at least level 17 (stage 9's: decision D3-6), so the growth never waits on a grind.

stages.objective: Climb to the Stormstair, the flooded pools at the top of the Drowned Steps
stages.waiting_text: The Stormstair lies north of the Mere of Kings, under the Stonehold's wall west of the Giant's Stair; the storm stands over it.

stages.objective: Bring down the Stormcaller in his flooded pools
Tell Maera at Last Hearth the storm is broken
